slides.title: X3100 Offline X-ray Component Counter
slides.subtitle: Operation Manual - English
slides.tagline: Read this manual before installing or operating the machine. Keep it with the machine.

slides.title: Safety
slides.text: The X3100 is an X-ray device. Only trained staff may operate it. Read every warning in this chapter before switching on.

slides.title: Warnings that apply every day

cards.b: Never open the door while X-ray is on. The interlocks stop X-ray; do not rely on them as a routine.
Never bypass door interlocks 1 and 2 or the double safety circuit.
Press the emergency stop in any abnormal situation.
Never touch the beryllium window of the X-ray tube.

slides.banner: Stop X-ray first, every time - even with the interlocks working.

slides.title: Daily operation
slides.text: Start-up, a four-reel count and shut-down.

steps.b: Main power on, PC on, release the emergency stop, start the counting software.
Choose the operator account and enter the password.
Select print, auto barcode scan and single or multi-reel mode, then press start.
Place the reels, press both start buttons, wait for the result.
Take reels out one by one; apply each printed label.

slides.title: Most stoppages are cleared by settings
rows: Adjust image brightness; check the part type
Set auto scan and the right code type
Flat panel or X-ray init failed
Previous session did not close - restart the software
Stop X-ray, tag the machine, contact Southern Machinery service

facts.b: Note the reel ID, part type, mode and what the screen shows; stop X-ray and keep the door closed.
Send photos or a short video of the screen and the fault to our engineers.
Quote the machine serial number from the nameplate.
